1. Applying updated `StatefulSet/redis-cluster` memory request (`384Mi`) and limit (`768Mi`) via `containers/kubernetes-mcp-server` `resources_create_or_update`.
2. Invoking Kubernetes 1.35+ GA In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling (`PATCH /api/v1/namespaces/payments/pods/redis-cluster-0/resize`).
